subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android retire the separate Voice destination and make realtime Talk an embedded Chat-composer state as part of this dictation feature?
rationale: The patch changes a broader established navigation and session presentation model, not only a new microphone action; source tests can cover mechanics but cannot establish the intended Android product direction.

options.title: Sponsor unified Chat/Talk
options.body: Approve retiring the visible Voice destination after the contributor refreshes the branch and proves both dictation insertion and the embedded Talk flow on the final head.

options.title: Split dictation from navigation
options.body: Keep the bounded inline-dictation and microphone-ownership work, while deferring Voice-tab retirement and embedded Talk presentation to a separately sponsored design change.

options.title: Keep the current Voice model
options.body: Retain the existing Voice destination and close or substantially narrow this PR if the unified navigation model is not desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor unified Chat/Talk
recommendation.body: Approve retiring the visible Voice destination after the contributor refreshes the branch and proves both dictation insertion and the embedded Talk flow on the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to Solvely-Colin and their branch commits cover the dictation and microphone-ownership portion most affected by the decision.
